material_findings: zero-on-missing could erase adverse competitor evidence
golden feature vectors were not jointly realizable
reference-box and LK operational symmetry needed freezing

review_history.basis: All material findings were corrected and the revised pre-review checker passed.

checks.finding: Both candidates share reference-box provenance, LK validity, age, box, and optional-evidence rules.

checks.challenge: core evidence is sufficient but not excessive
checks.finding: IoU and freshness are scored; correlated center and scale quantities are diagnostic only.
Missing channels use full uncertainty and activation uses the lower bound.

checks.challenge: feasibility does not rely on impossible perfect matches
checks.finding: Features are recomputed from realizable raw boxes, descriptors, predictions, ages, and LK states.

checks.challenge: threshold and margin have a non-degenerate range
checks.finding: Support margin 0.25 and lower-bound threshold 0.625 are one gate with three non-empty regions.

checks.challenge: design is not post-hoc activation forcing
checks.finding: The gate is frozen before score-blind telemetry and cannot be tuned from validation or tracking quality.

checks.challenge: another hidden-owner iteration is scientifically worthwhile
checks.finding: One reservation-disabled telemetry probe is falsifiable and has a hard hypothesis-close rule.

residual_limitations: actual selected-competitor support density is unknown
threshold and weights are domain-chosen and uncalibrated
motion and selected reference geometry may remain correlated
score-blind development owner labels may contain GT ambiguity
